latestVersion.changelog:
Free Video Editing AI – Initial Release

- Launches the first version of an AI-powered video editing tool for automatic processing of raw footage into polished, shareable 1080p MP4 videos.
- Supports MP4, MOV, AVI, and WebM uploads up to 500MB; exports high-quality MP4s after AI editing in 1–2 minutes.
- Simple onboarding with automatic backend connection and free 7-day token generation; no registration required for first-time users.
- Robust API workflows for uploading, editing, previewing, and exporting videos, including handling text overlays, BGM, and more.
- Detailed error handling for common issues (tokens, file format/size, credits, export limits).
